description: This is a Java test class named `Mqtt5ValidatorTest` that validates the functionality of the `Mqtt5Validator` class related to MQTT v5 message validation within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests verifying correct address formats, immutability, and exception handling for invalid configurations of MQTT connection objects.

classes.name: Mqtt5ValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for `Mqtt5Validator`, testing validation logic for MQTT connections, including address formatting, immutability, and exception handling for invalid configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system used for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after tests are completed.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of `Mqtt5Validator` are immutable.

methods.name: testValidSourceAddress
methods.description: Tests valid source addresses for MQTT topics.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceAddress
methods.description: Tests various invalid source addresses and expects exceptions.

methods.name: testClientCountGreaterOneIsPossible
methods.description: Checks that client count greater than one is accepted.

methods.name: testConsumerCountGreaterOneIsPossible
methods.description: Checks that consumer count greater than one is accepted.

methods.name: testInsecureProtocolAndCertificates
methods.description: Verifies that insecure protocols with trusted certificates raise validation exceptions.

methods.name: testInvalidTargetAddress
methods.description: Tests invalid target addresses expecting exceptions.

methods.name: testWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Ensures invalid connection with default source configuration throws exception.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceTopicFilters
methods.description: Tests various invalid source topic filters.

methods.name: testInvalidEnforcementOrigin
methods.description: Tests invalid enforcement origin in source configurations.

methods.name: connectionWithSource
methods.description: Helper to create a connection with a specific source string.

methods.name: connectionWithSource
methods.description: Helper overload to create a connection with a Source object.

methods.name: connectionWithTarget
methods.description: Helper to create a connection with specific target address.

methods.name: verifyConnectionConfigurationInvalidExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Asserts that invalid connection configurations throw the expected exception.
